author: Atomic Shrimp
description:
This is an idea I meant to try out last year but missed the season; it's also been a thing a few people suggested I should try, so here we go - wild garlic buds, pickled for use like capers.

Join the Atomic Shrimp official Discord server for FREE early access to videos! - https://discord.gg/atomicshrimp
